hypothesis: c027 (cap 31.36) is the strongest robust parent; a modest x0.7 tightening of the per-net weight cap to ~21.95 keeps the broad TNS benefit while slightly reducing the risk of the HBT-spacing/legalization failures seen when the cap was pushed too far, giving a safe confirmation/refinement.
analysis: The hypothesis held: all runs valid, robust mean-std +0.230, min_case +0.217, total +0.826. Every case improved, with bp-ng45 the weakest (dWNS +18.6%, dTNS +23.9%) and ariane133-ng45 strongest (dTNS +39.8%). The x0.7 cap tightening preserved broad TNS gains while avoiding the HBT-spacing/legalization failures, consistent with reduced per-net weight pressure. Next step: sweep cap between 21.95 and 31.36 (e.g., x0.8, x0.85) to locate the knee where TNS benefit saturates before legality risk reappears.
